changelog:
New Auto Montage in Studio: your plays cut to the beat of a song with transitions, effects, rewinds and different endings, 5 styles
New Projects in Studio: mix many games in one video, or make one from your best of today, this week or this month
Studio: pick or add back any moment, and your chosen games and moments stay saved with the edit
Studio: search for a song by name, better montage music picks and more reliable song downloads
New Combo and Team wipe markers, and montages only use fights you were in, never the death screen
Studio: smoother preview, and exports no longer freeze or lose half a transition, and come out sharper
Subtitles much faster on NVIDIA cards, GTX 16 series included
Clips: turning recording off and on no longer breaks instant replay, and manual mode no longer resumes by itself
Blacklists: Urchin is now called Coral
Blacklists: choose for every tag whether it alerts, only shows or is hidden, and an option for verified Xadia tags only
Real Hypixel star icons in messages, and the Short
